title: The Hobbit Eternal: card flavor text

entities.name: Frodo Baggins
entities.description: A Hobbit and Ring-bearer who resists, and sometimes gives in to, the temptation to put on the Ring.

entities.name: The One Ring
entities.description: The Ring borne by Frodo; when he puts it on, Sauron becomes aware of it.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: A people who love their land and works, yet would cast all away rather than submit to Sauron.

entities.name: Sauron
entities.description: The Enemy whom the Elves refuse to submit to; he becomes aware of his folly when Frodo puts on the Ring.

entities.name: Galadriel
entities.description: An Elf who speaks of how Lothlórien is maintained and defended against its Enemy.

entities.name: Aragorn
entities.description: A leader of the Dúnedain who bears Andúril and the Star of Elendil, and weds Arwen in the city of the Kings.

entities.name: Arwen Undómiel
entities.description: An Elf who weds Aragorn and becomes Queen, singing a song of Valinor as the White Tree blossoms.

entities.name: Treebeard
entities.description: An Ent who explains why the Ents are marching.

entities.name: Ents
entities.description: Tree-folk who march to war rather than wait for doom to find them.

entities.name: Andúril
entities.description: The Sword of Elendil, Narsil, forged anew by Elvish smiths and borne by Aragorn.

entities.name: Elendil
entities.description: A figure of old whose sword and star are borne by Aragorn.

entities.name: Star of Elendil
entities.description: A jewel worn upon Aragorn's brow.

entities.name: Gandalf
entities.description: A wizard who warns that the Shadow always grows again and guides the company through Moria.

entities.name: Minas Tirith
entities.description: A city with walls so strong and old they seemed carved from the bones of the earth.

entities.name: Rivendell
entities.description: Elrond's house in a deep valley where the Fair Folk dwell in peace.

entities.name: Elrond
entities.description: Master of Rivendell who explains the purpose of the Three Rings of the Elves.

entities.name: White Tree
entities.description: A tree that grew and blossomed while Queen Arwen sang.

entities.name: Valinor
entities.description: A land of which Queen Arwen sang a song.

entities.name: Samwise Gamgee
entities.description: A Hobbit who quotes his gaffer and recites troll rhymes.

entities.name: The Gaffer
entities.description: Sam's father, given to sayings about gardening.

entities.name: Witch-king
entities.description: A dreadful being who returned to the air, bringing ruin and turning hope to despair.

entities.name: Bilbo Baggins
entities.description: A Hobbit whose unexpected return caused wonder, who never looks older, and who leaves to finish his book.

entities.name: Bilbo's Ring
entities.description: A ring under which its bearer goes on living, never looking a day older.

entities.name: Lotho
entities.description: A Hobbit in whose name ruffians rule and ruin the Shire.

entities.name: The Shire
entities.description: A pleasant corner of the world where the Hobbits live their well-ordered lives.

entities.name: Hobbits
entities.description: The people of the Shire.

entities.name: Bard
entities.description: A warrior whose strength of arms shows the might of the old lords of Dale, and who sent for aid.

entities.name: Dale
entities.description: A realm once ruled by mighty old lords.

entities.name: Bolg
entities.description: A goblin whose hatred of Dwarves grew after they killed his father Azog and the Great Goblin.

entities.name: Azog
entities.description: Bolg's father, killed by Dwarves.

entities.name: Great Goblin
entities.description: A goblin leader killed by Dwarves.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.description: A people who killed Azog and the Great Goblin.

entities.name: Erebor
entities.description: The place named in Bolg's reckoning.

entities.name: Dáin
entities.description: A Dwarf who came in haste to his kinsman's aid and defended him in fury.

entities.name: Thranduil
entities.description: The Elvenking, who knew of Smaug's death and planned to march before Bard sent for aid.

entities.name: Smaug
entities.description: A dragon whose death the Elvenking learned of.

entities.name: Gondor
entities.description: A realm in great need, ruled by Lord Denethor.

entities.name: Denethor
entities.description: Lord of Gondor who asks for all strength and speed lest Gondor fall.

entities.name: Rohirrim
entities.description: Horse-riders lamented in song.

entities.name: Rohan
entities.description: The realm of the Lady of Rohan.

entities.name: Éowyn
entities.description: The Lady of Rohan, laid low by a malady along with the Halfling.

entities.name: Dúnedain
entities.description: A people whom Aragorn says keep the roads safe.

entities.name: Barrow-Downs
entities.description: A fog-covered place of a cold chant of the dead.

entities.name: Landroval
entities.description: A great flier who passed over Udûn and Gorgoroth and saw Mount Doom blazing.

entities.name: Udûn
entities.description: A land in ruin beneath Landroval; its flame is invoked as 'flame of Udûn'.

entities.name: Gorgoroth
entities.description: A land in ruin and tumult.

entities.name: Mount Doom
entities.description: A mountain seen blazing.

entities.name: Grey Host
entities.description: The Dead who awaken because the hour has come for the oathbreakers.

entities.name: Éomer
entities.description: A rider who reports Great Orcs bearing the White Hand of Isengard.

entities.name: Orcs
entities.description: Enemy warriors, some bearing the White Hand of Isengard.

entities.name: Isengard
entities.description: The realm whose White Hand the Great Orcs bore.

entities.name: White Hand
entities.description: The emblem of Isengard borne by Great Orcs.

entities.name: Corsairs of Umbar
entities.description: A fleet from the South who no longer fear Gondor's might.

entities.name: Umbar
entities.description: A land in the South, home of the Corsairs.

entities.name: Anduin
entities.description: A river whose mouths a great fleet approaches.

entities.name: Beregond
entities.description: A man who warns of the Corsair fleet.

entities.name: Eärendil
entities.description: Subject of the Song of Eärendil.

entities.name: Song of Eärendil
entities.description: A song telling of a storm from Otherworld beyond the Sea.

entities.name: Grey Havens
entities.description: A place beyond the Shire from which elven-ships set sail, never to return.

entities.name: Ithilien
entities.description: Where the Hobbits spent many days after their reunion.

entities.name: Henneth Annûn
entities.description: Falls in Ithilien whose stream could be heard at night.

entities.name: Dol Amroth
entities.description: Home of knights who came to the Gate.

entities.name: Haldir
entities.description: An Elf of Lórien who welcomes travelers and watches enemies.

entities.name: Lothlórien
entities.description: An Elvish land maintained and defended against its Enemy, where Elves dwell in trees.

entities.name: Naith of Lórien
entities.description: A part of Lórien with trees Haldir bids travelers behold.

entities.name: Galadhrim
entities.description: The Elves of Lórien, who dwell in trees.

entities.name: Legolas
entities.description: An Elf who explains the customs of the Galadhrim.

entities.name: Pelargir
entities.description: A place assailed by the Corsairs.

entities.name: Boromir
entities.description: A man who tried to take the Ring from Frodo and says he has paid.

entities.name: Gollum
entities.description: A creature who warns not to look in when the candles are lit.

entities.name: Dead Marshes
entities.description: A haunted marsh.

entities.name: Saruman
entities.description: A figure cursed in Orcish.

entities.name: Khazad-dûm
entities.description: A great Dwarven realm become dark and dreadful.

entities.name: Balin
entities.description: A Dwarf shot by an Orc from behind a stone.

entities.name: Book of Mazarbul
entities.description: A written record of the Dwarves' fate in Moria.

entities.name: Orthanc
entities.description: Source of a devilry the Orcs brought.

entities.name: Gimli
entities.description: A Dwarf who has looked on Moria.

entities.name: Celeborn
entities.description: An Elf with eyes keen as lances and wells of deep memory.

entities.name: Three Rings of the Elves
entities.description: Rings made not for war but for understanding, making, and healing.

entities.name: Flame of Anor
entities.description: A power invoked against the dark fire, the flame of Udûn.

entities.name: Fall of Sauron
entities.description: The year of Sauron's fall, at whose Midsummer Aragorn and Arwen wed.

events.summary: Frodo decides to go with the other Ring-bearers.
events.quote: "Yes, I am coming," said Frodo. "The Ring-bearers should go together."

events.summary: Treebeard explains that the Ents are marching to war rather than waiting for doom.
events.quote: That is why we are marching now.

events.summary: The Sword of Elendil is forged anew by Elvish smiths.
events.quote: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths.

events.summary: Queen Arwen sings a song of Valinor as the White Tree blossoms.
events.quote: While the Tree grew and blossomed, Queen Arwen sang a song of Valinor.

events.summary: The Witch-king returns to the air bringing ruin.
events.quote: To the air he had returned, bringing ruin, turning hope to despair, and victory to death.

events.summary: Bilbo returns unexpectedly to confusion and wonder.
events.quote: Bilbo's return was quite unexpected, met with confusion and worry but also wonder and awe.

events.summary: Aragorn and Arwen are wedded in the city of the Kings at Midsummer in the year of the Fall of Sauron.
events.quote: Aragorn took the hand of Arwen Undómiel, and they were wedded in the city of the Kings.

events.summary: Frodo reports ruffians ruling the Shire in Lotho's name.
events.quote: The ruffians are on top—gathering, robbing, bullying, and running or ruining things as they like, in his name.

events.summary: Bolg's hatred of Dwarves, born when they killed Azog, blazes after they kill the Great Goblin.
events.quote: When they killed the Great Goblin, the embers became a blaze.

events.summary: Dáin comes to his kinsman's aid and defends him.
events.quote: In haste Dáin had come to his kinsman's aid, and in fury he now defended him.

events.summary: Thranduil learns of Smaug's death and plans to march before Bard asks for aid.
events.quote: Even before Bard sent for aid, the Elvenking knew of Smaug's death and had already made plans to march.

events.summary: Aragorn leads the way bearing Andúril and the Star of Elendil.
events.quote: Before all went Aragorn with the Flame of the West

events.summary: Denethor's errand-rider asks for aid lest Gondor fall.
events.quote: Gondor is in great need.

events.summary: Landroval flies over Udûn and Gorgoroth and sees Mount Doom blazing.
events.quote: He passed over Udûn and Gorgoroth and saw all the land in ruin and tumult beneath him, and before him Mount Doom blazing.

events.summary: The Dead awaken to fulfil the oath.
events.quote: The Dead awaken; for the hour is come for the oathbreakers.

events.summary: Beregond warns of the Corsair fleet nearing the mouths of Anduin.
events.quote: There is a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin, manned by the Corsairs of Umbar in the South.

events.summary: After their reunion, the Hobbits spend many days in Ithilien.
events.quote: After their reunion, the Hobbits spent many days in Ithilien.

events.summary: Boromir confesses he tried to take the Ring from Frodo and has paid.
events.quote: "I tried to take the Ring from Frodo. I am sorry. I have paid."

events.summary: The Halfling and the Lady of Rohan fall gravely ill.
events.quote: Soon they began to fall down into the darkness, and as the sun turned west, a grey shadow crept over their faces.

events.summary: Frodo puts on the Ring and Sauron becomes aware of his folly.
events.quote: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly.

events.summary: The Book of Mazarbul records Balin shot by an Orc.
events.quote: "An Orc shot Balin from behind a stone. We slew the Orc, but many more came."

events.summary: Bilbo announces he is leaving to finish his book.
events.quote: I'm leaving; for somewhere where I can finish my book, perhaps.

relations.note: They refuse to submit to him.
relations.quote: Yet they will cast all away rather than submit to Sauron

relations.note: Rivendell is the house of Elrond.
relations.quote: Many desired to see the house of Elrond
Before all went Aragorn with the Flame of the West—Andúril

relations.note: Great Orcs bearing the White Hand.
relations.quote: Great Orcs, who also bore the White Hand of Isengard.
They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.

relations.note: Elves of Lórien dwelling in trees.
relations.quote: That was the custom of the Elves of Lórien, to dwell in the trees.

relations.note: Tried to take the Ring from him.
relations.quote: I tried to take the Ring from Frodo.
Lord Denethor asks for all your strength and all your speed, lest Gondor fall at last.

relations.note: Aragorn calls it where his heart dwells.
relations.quote: Here is the heart of Elvendom on earth, and here my heart dwells ever.

rejected.summary: The travelers are refreshed at the Last Homely House.
rejected.quote: All of them, the ponies as well, grew refreshed and strong in a few days at the Last Homely House.
